# The arrest

The pair [B7F3]{term=b7f3} stops after release [@levin2025].[^why] The same holds for its
sibling, described in the [companion report](https://lab.specterlab.org/#/p/rpt-002?revision=005&section=siblings).

[^why]: The lobes decouple.
